subject: Re: SDLC evidence request — delegated change ownership & secret escrow
messages:
From: Harper Liu <harper.liu@veridianbank.com>
To: security-assessor@trustaudits.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SDLC follow-up: delegated change ownership + secrets escrow

Hi Markus / TrustAudits team,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. As part of our SOC 2 pre-assessment we're collecting focused proof around two areas we discussed: 1) delegated change ownership (who can approve production config changes, how approvals are recorded) and 2) secrets escrow/rotation (vault custody, short-lived creds, exception flows).

Can you share a narrow evidence bundle showing:
- a current deploy/ change ownership matrix (names/roles + Jira ticket examples)
- CI approval logs for at least 3 recent production deployments showing reviewer/approver stamps
- a snapshot of vault rotation policy and an example rotation event (no secrets in the email, just metadata)
- any documented exception/rollback checklist used by SREs when secrets are compromised

We're aiming to complete our draft report by EOD Tuesday (2026-08-10). Short extracts are fine; we prefer clear timestamps and links to canonical artifacts.

Cheers,
Harper Liu
Senior Security Analyst — Veridian Bank
harper.liu@veridianbank.com

--
From: security-assessor@trustaudits.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-08T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC follow-up: delegated change ownership + secrets escrow

Markus,

Quick thread from our side to clarify scoping: we only need artifacts that show operational controls in production path (deploy approvals, who can approve emergency rollouts, how ephemeral tokens are issued and revoked). Redacted logs are acceptable; include hashes/IDs that map back to your internal records.

If you can provide an initial packet today, we will triage and ask follow-ups only for gaps.

Thanks,
TrustAudits Team
security-assessor@trustaudits.com

--
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-08T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SDLC follow-up: delegated change ownership + secrets escrow

Irene / Jordan — forwarding Veridian's ask and TA clarifications. Please assemble the bundle below and upload to the shared drive link. Kim, please confirm we can include the CI log extracts and the vault rotation metadata without additional redaction.

Deliverables we should prepare (minimal, evidence-focused):
- deploy-ownership-matrix.pdf (role -> capability -> escalation path)
- ci-approval-logs.csv (last 3 prod deploys; include ticket IDs, approver, timestamp)
- vault-rotation-snapshot.txt (policy metadata + rotation event ids)
- change-request-examples.zip (sanitized Jira exports showing approvals + reviewers)

Note: Include the Jira ticket anchors so external assessor can cross-reference. Mark the emergency approval flow separately. If anything here needs legal review before sharing, flag it.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SDLC follow-up: delegated change ownership + secrets escrow

Markus — assembling now. Quick notes and outstanding clarifications:

1) Deploy ownership matrix: attaching a PDF draft that maps teams to approval scopes. This includes a separate section for on-call SRE emergency approvals (2-step approval: on-call SRE + engineering manager).
2) CI approval logs: we can export the pipeline approval artifacts (we'll redact job output and token values). We will include ticket IDs (SEC-1221, PROD-4427, REL-3991) and approver emails.
3) Vault rotation: we will include rotation metadata (rotation_id, rotation_time, KMS-reference) but not key material.
4) Exception flow: we have an internal rollback checklist used by SREs — I'll include the latest signed version.

Questions: Do they need the full PR diff evidence for one of the deploys or just the PR approval chain and merge timestamps?

Planned uploads by EOD 2026-08-09.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: deploy-ownership-matrix.pdf (draft)
From: security-assessor@trustaudits.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC follow-up: delegated change ownership + secrets escrow

Hi Irene / Markus,

PR diffs not required at this stage — approval chain + merge/ deploy timestamps are sufficient. We will request diffs only if we have a traceability question. The artifacts you listed sound fine. Please ensure the CI log extracts include the pipeline step name and the approver identity.

Also, please include one example of an emergency approval ticket (with timeline and who executed rollback) — that helps validate the exception process.

Regards,
TrustAudits Team
security-assessor@trustaudits.com
